Automatic effort and model, and a quota that limits how many agents run, not how well one runs. Every request runs at the effort its grade calls for (zetetic-genius) and the main tool loop steps down the ladder. Its effort is the Agent call's, else the one its definition sets; an inheriting type for which neither sets one runs every step at the effort of the turn's grade (main's spawns on a graded turn; a fork, a workflow agent or a teammate is never rewritten). No pressure, quota or context changes a model or an effort the orchestrator designed. Each spawn's requested, definition and decided model, what ran, the effort decided for its steps and a short reason for each are kept per session. Quota pressure limits concurrency: the cap on subagents running at once falls from max_parallel_agents (5) at an empty five-hour window to 1 at quota_pressure_percent, and a spawn past it is refused with a message the orchestrator reads (wait for a running agent to finish).
